hidden_generation.method: HMAC-derived evaluator variant selection and option permutation
hidden_generation.candidate_visibility: candidate receives only generated visible scenarios/options; HMAC seed and expected choice map are never included in prompt/output

claim_boundary: This gate qualifies semantic professional judgment and inherited truth/safety/device/experiment invariants only. It cannot by itself qualify artifact-first still/video observation or human operator executability.

budget.stop_condition: missing secret/runtime, frozen identity mismatch, provider failure, malformed output, first trial mismatch, or completed PASS
